notes: Changed files say so: Save As of a file you changed in E-Sys's own SVT editor or FDL-Editor suggests the file's name with MODIFIED in it, so a changed copy is never mixed up with the original. An unchanged file keeps E-Sys's own name, and so does a coding file in E-Sys's CAF folder (Code NCD codes exactly that file). A changed NCD saved with MODIFIED in its name is no longer filed in the backups as if it was read from the car. E-Sys left hanging without any window: pressing play now asks whether to end it and start E-Sys with E-Sys MAX, instead of only saying it is open (nothing is ended without your Yes, and an E-Sys showing any window, even a question box, is never ended).
